case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
sup:70510.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
sup:70510.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
message.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost drivers so clearly. We value our cooperation and take the copper development seriously.

Our data shows a somewhat different picture:

Your quality was 273 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70510@2026Q3).

German labour costs in manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

To make this easy to take to your pricing committee, we have structured three options. Option A answers your interest in a stronger price by offering a longer payment term, so please compare them as a set:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 339.74; payment 60 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 329.81; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option C: unit price EUR 337.49; payment 30 days net; no index clause.

We are happy to provide any further documentation your approval needs.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Our current offer is a price of €372.65 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

Building on your Option C, we agree to maintain the 30-day payment term without introducing an index clause. To accommodate this structure, we can revise our price to €370.60 per unit. 

Alternatively, at our standard terms with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €370.60 per unit, no Preisgleitklausel.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Quality Management: We meet the agreed quality targets.

Option A: unit price EUR 343.85; payment 60 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 333.80; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option C: unit price EUR 341.57; payment 30 days net; no index clause.

Option A and Option B answer your interest in clear payment terms. If your committee needs anything further from us, we are glad to provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have received your revised offer and note your movement. However, the gap remains significant given the documented increases in our raw material costs. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We can provide our offer at a price of €372.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Building on your Option C, we can offer a revised price of EUR 370.41 per unit with a 30-day payment term. As an alternative at standard terms, we offer a price of €370.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
